note: Release profiles for scripts/check-release-manifest.mjs. A profile names the control-register controls (control-N) that MUST be implemented/verified before a release under that profile can ship, even while the wider programme still has pending controls. This is the fail-closed middle ground between --mode draft (permits any incomplete control) and --mode production (requires every control complete). The deploy workflow selects a profile with --profile <name>.

historical-demo.description: Public historical-only service (past elections; no live ballot). Blocks release on the legally-material controls identified in legal review: print authorisation, ballot + candidate-mapping verification, public privacy representations, source and data licensing, operator identity, and the security controls publicly described as operational. Other controls may remain partial/pending.
